loyaltyProgramEnrollment.description: Fires when a user enrolls in or updates their membership status within the loyalty program.

user.description: Container object that holds authenticated user identity and loyalty program tier or membership status.

Booking Completion.description: Fires when a travel booking (hotel, flight, package) is successfully completed, capturing the full transaction including items, pricing, fees, booking reference, and user loyalty status.

transaction.description: Container object that holds booking transaction details including itemized accommodations or services, pricing, taxes, fees, channel, currency, and unique transaction identifier.
